registers.name: tcop_version
registers.description: Tensor Coprocessor Version Register. Reports the major and minor IP versions.

fields.name: major
fields.description:
Major version field. Identifies the compatible major IP generation.

Usage: Read after reset; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x1 major version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: 16-bit unsigned version number.

fields.name: minor
fields.description:
Minor version field. Identifies compatible additions within a major IP generation.

Usage: Read after reset; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x1 minor version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: 16-bit unsigned version number.

registers.name: tcop_ctrl
registers.description: Tensor Coprocessor Control Register. Enables command acceptance and acknowledges a checked OP-003 scalar result.

fields.name: en
fields.description:
Enable field. Allows the IP to accept and launch supported tensor commands.

Usage: Write 1 before issuing commands in a build that includes APB CSR. Clear only when the queue is empty and the datapath is idle.

Values:
0x0 command acceptance disabled (reset value);
0x1 command acceptance enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit control.

fields.name: scalar_ack
fields.description:
One-shot scalar-check acknowledge request. Releases the global OP-003 fence after software has checked a zero-valued scalar result and any error record.

Usage: In PARA_CTRL_MODE=2, write 1 only after an OP-003 result of zero has been observed and tcop_sts.err_valid has been checked. If err_valid is 1, read and record the complete first-error record and clear err_valid with W1C. Hardware consumes this request only while an OP-003 scalar-check fence is pending, and only after err_valid is clear in CLK-CORE. A request arriving when no scalar check is pending is discarded and shall not remain set for a later OP-003. Wait until tcop_sts.busy becomes 0 before releasing the global submission lock. Do not write this field when no OP-003 zero-result check is pending.

Values:
0x0 no scalar acknowledgment request (reset value);
0x1 acknowledge the inspected OP-003 zero result.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit write-only request transferred by an asynchronous request/acknowledge handshake; hardware clears it after consumption. Write the full APB word and preserve tcop_ctrl.en.

registers.name: tcop_sts
registers.description: Tensor Coprocessor Status Register. Reports live work and first-error record validity.

fields.name: busy
fields.description:
Busy field. Indicates active or queued accepted tensor work, or a pending OP-003 zero-result scalar-check fence.

Usage: Read at any time; software does not write this field. The field stays high after an OP-003 zero result has completed over CV-X-IF and remains high until the scalar acknowledgment is consumed.

Values:
0x0 no accepted command is active or queued and no OP-003 scalar-check fence is pending (reset value);
0x1 accepted work or a scalar-check fence is pending.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit synchronized status.

fields.name: err_valid
fields.description:
First-error valid field. Indicates that the sticky first-error record contains a command failure.

Usage: Read the complete error record before writing 1 to clear. Younger execution pauses until the W1C clear acknowledgment reaches CLK-CORE. For an OP-003 zero-result fence, clearing err_valid alone does not release the global fence; software must also write tcop_ctrl.scalar_ack=1 after checking the result.

Values:
0x0 no valid error record (reset value or after W1C);
0x1 a first-error record is valid. After the OP-003 zero-result handshake, while scalar_check_pending=1, 0 means the completed zero result is valid and 1 means that OP-003 failed.

Unit: none

Limits: One-bit sticky status; writes of 0 have no effect.

registers.name: tcop_err_sts
registers.description: Tensor Coprocessor First Error Status Register. Holds the DEC-012 status code.

fields.name: code
fields.description:
Status field. Contains the stable status enumeration for the first accepted command error.

Usage: Read only when tcop_sts.err_valid is 1.

Values:
0x0 no error status (reset value or no valid record);
0x1 to 0xFFFFFFFF nonzero DEC-012 error code.

Unit: status enum

Limits: 32-bit unsigned status code; see HDS Section 12.1.

registers.name: tcop_err_hartid
registers.description: Tensor Coprocessor First Error Hart Register. Identifies the CV-X-IF hart that issued the error command.

fields.name: hartid
fields.description:
Hart field. Contains the zero-extended CV-X-IF hart ID associated with the first error.

Usage: Read only when tcop_sts.err_valid is 1.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF zero-extended hart ID.

Unit: hart ID

Limits: 32-bit zero-extended identifier; stable while err_valid is 1.

registers.name: tcop_err_xif_id
registers.description: Tensor Coprocessor First Error Command Register. Identifies the CV-X-IF command transaction.

fields.name: xif_id
fields.description:
Transaction field. Contains the zero-extended CV-X-IF transaction ID associated with the first error.

Usage: Read only when tcop_sts.err_valid is 1.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF zero-extended CV-X-IF transaction ID.

Unit: transaction ID

Limits: 32-bit zero-extended identifier; stable while err_valid is 1.

registers.name: tcop_err_addr_lo
registers.description: Tensor Coprocessor First Error Address Low Register. Holds the low half of the associated DMA byte address.

fields.name: addr_lo
fields.description:
Address field. Contains address bits [31:0] for a DMA address-related error.

Usage: Read with tcop_err_addr_hi only when tcop_sts.err_valid is 1.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF low address bits, or zero when no DMA address applies.

Unit: byte address

Limits: Low 32 bits of a 64-bit DMA-visible byte address.

registers.name: tcop_err_addr_hi
registers.description: Tensor Coprocessor First Error Address High Register. Holds the high half of the associated DMA byte address.

fields.name: addr_hi
fields.description:
Address field. Contains address bits [63:32] for a DMA address-related error.

Usage: Read with tcop_err_addr_lo only when tcop_sts.err_valid is 1.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF high address bits, or zero when no DMA address applies.

Unit: byte address

Limits: High 32 bits of a 64-bit DMA-visible byte address.

registers.name: tcop_err_axi_id
registers.description: Tensor Coprocessor First Error AXI ID Register. Holds the associated AXI transaction identifier.

fields.name: axi_id
fields.description:
AXI ID field. Contains the zero-extended AXI transaction ID for an AXI response/protocol error.

Usage: Read only when tcop_sts.err_valid is 1.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF zero-extended AXI ID, or zero when no AXI ID applies.

Unit: transaction ID

Limits: 32-bit zero-extended AXI ID; stable while err_valid is 1.

registers.name: tcop_err_detail
registers.description: Tensor Coprocessor First Error Detail Register. Reserved for a future diagnostic subcode map; release 1 reads as zero for every status.

fields.name: detail
fields.description:
Reserved detail field. In release 1, hardware reads zero for every error status; software shall not assign subcode semantics to this field.

Usage: Reserved for a future versioned CSR/IP extension. Software control flow shall use tcop_err_sts.code only.

Values:
0x00000000 for every status in release 1.

Unit: none in release 1.

Limits: Read-only, reserved zero; stable while err_valid is 1.
